DML.SELECT: SELECT command_element_type_id as "commandElementTypeId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", command_element_type_param_id as "commandElementTypeParamId", command_element_id as "commandElementId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.command_element_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.command_element_values (command_element_type_id, element_type_id, command_element_type_param_id, command_element_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:commandElementTypeId, :elementTypeId, :commandElementTypeParamId, :commandElementId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.command_element_values WHERE command_element_type_id = :commandElementTypeId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND command_element_type_param_id = :commandElementTypeParamId AND command_element_id = :commandElementId
